name: Sync Public Subset

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      public_repository:
        description: Public repository in owner/name format. Overrides repository variable when provided.
        required: false
        type: string
      public_branch:
        description: Public repository branch to push to. Overrides repository variable when provided.
        required: false
        default: main
        type: string
  push: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  sync-public-subset:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PUBLIC_REPOSITORY: ${{ inputs.public_repository || vars.PUBLIC_SYNC_REPOSITORY || 'pal-semiopen/life_management_open' }}
      PUBLIC_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.public_branch || vars.PUBLIC_SYNC_BRANCH || 'main' }}
      PLACEHOLDER_NAME: このパスには公開対象ファイルがありません.txt
    steps:
      - name: Validate workflow configuration
        env:
          PUBLIC_SYNC_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_SYNC_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$PUBLIC_REPOSITORY" ]; then
            echo "PUBLIC_SYNC_REPOSITORY is not set. Configure a repository variable or pass workflow_dispatch input public_repository." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$PUBLIC_SYNC_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "PUBLIC_SYNC_TOKEN secret is not set." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Show resolved sync target
        run: |
          echo "PUBLIC_REPOSITORY=$PUBLIC_REPOSITORY"
          echo "PUBLIC_BRANCH=$PUBLIC_BRANCH"

      - name: Checkout private repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Build public subset staging
        run: |
          python scripts/build_public_subset.py \
            --root . \
            --output-dir .public_staging \
            --placeholder-name "$PLACEHOLDER_NAME"

      - name: Checkout public repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          repository: ${{ env.PUBLIC_REPOSITORY }}
          ref: ${{ env.PUBLIC_BRANCH }}
          token: ${{ secrets.PUBLIC_SYNC_TOKEN }}
          path: .public_repo
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Replace public repository contents
        shell: bash
        run: |
          find .public_repo -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name '.git' -exec rm -rf {} +
          cp -R .public_staging/. .public_repo/

      - name: Commit and push when changed
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd .public_repo
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "No public subset changes detected."
            exit 0
          fi

          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore: sync public subset from ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${PUBLIC_BRANCH}"
